observations.behavior: Adds a conditional check to clear transient 'not_started' errors when an active trial is still dispatching the run's workflow.
observations.posthog_connection: This could prevent false-positive error displays in the Scout Trials UI while backend workflows are initializing. P1

observations.behavior: Checks current state before registering server comparison history; this guards against stale or inconsistent status updates from early API responses.
observations.posthog_connection: Could reduce unnecessary re-renders and avoid displaying incorrect statuses during initial load of comparison histories.

observations.behavior: Changes how downloaded results are constructed by explicitly checking `values.results[row.launchId]` rather than relying on potentially missing cached data.
observations.posthog_connection: Makes exported JSON more reliable for users downloading reports, especially if some launch results have not yet been populated locally.

observations.limitations: All hunks are either documentation changes or tests. The implementation changes are limited to one file with no shared dependency or broader system change.
